    REG_EEPROM2 = 0x06
    REG_TEMP_OFFSET = 0x07
    REG_EEPROM3 = 0x08
    REG_DEVICE_ID = 0x0F

        self.regs[self.REG_TEMP] = 0x8000  # -256°C
        self.regs[self.REG_CONFIG] = 0x0220  # Factory reset value
        self.regs[self.REG_THIGH] = 0x6000  # Factory reset value
        self.regs[self.REG_TLOW] = 0x8000  # Factory reset value
        self.regs[self.REG_EEPROM_UL] = 0x0000  # EUN=0, EEPROM_Busy=0, UNUSED=0
        self.regs[self.REG_EEPROM1] = 0x0000  # Runtime value

        self.regs[self.REG_TEMP_OFFSET] = 0x0000  # Factory reset value
        self.regs[self.REG_EEPROM3] = 0x0000  # Runtime value
        self.regs[self.REG_DEVICE_ID] = 0x0117  # Device ID

        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address {addr:02X}")
        
        value = self.regs[addr]
        
        if addr == self.REG_CONFIG:
            # Clear read-to-clear flags
            value &= ~(1 << 15)  # HIGH_ALERT
            value &= ~(1 << 14)  # LOW_ALERT
            value &= ~(1 << 13)  # DATA_READY
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        else:

        if addr == self.REG_CONFIG or addr == self.REG_DEVICE_ID:
            # Read-only registers, ignore writes
            return
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            mask = 0xFF << 8
            data <<= 8
        else:
            mask = 0xFFFF
        
        self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & ~mask) | (data & mask)

from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TMP117_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_TEMP = 0x00
    REG_CONFIG = 0x01
    REG_THIGH = 0x02
    REG_TLOW = 0x03
    REG_EEPROM_UL = 0x04
    REG_EEPROM1 = 0x05
    REG_EEPROM2 = 0x06
    REG_TEMP_OFFSET = 0x07
    REG_EEPROM3 = 0x08
    REG_DEVICE_ID = 0x0F

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            self.REG_TEMP: 0x8000,          # -256°C
            self.REG_CONFIG: 0x0220,        # Factory reset value
            self.REG_THIGH: 0x6000,         # Factory reset value
            self.REG_TLOW: 0x8000,          # Factory reset value
            self.REG_EEPROM_UL: 0x0000,      # EUN=0, EEPROM_Busy=0, UNUSED=0
            self.REG_EEPROM1: 0x0000,        # Runtime value
            self.REG_EEPROM2: 0x0000,        # Runtime value
            self.REG_TEMP_OFFSET: 0x0000,    # Factory reset value
            self.REG_EEPROM3: 0x0000,        # Runtime value
            self.REG_DEVICE_ID: 0x0117       # Device ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr == self.REG_CONFIG:
            # Clear read-to-clear flags
            self.regs[self.REG_CONFIG] &= ~(0b111 << 12)
        
        value = self.regs.get(addr, 0)
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        
        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == self.REG_CONFIG:
            # Clear read-to-clear flags on write
            self.regs[self.REG_CONFIG] &= ~(0b111 << 12)
        
        if addr == self.REG_TEMP:
            # Temperature register is read-only
            return
        
        if addr == self.REG_DEVICE_ID:
            # Device ID register is read-only
            return
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Only update bits 15:8 for 1-byte write
            mask = 0xFF00
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & ~mask) | ((data << 8) & mask)
        else:
            self.regs[addr] = data
